newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY HYPO-BANK BOOSTS 96 PROFITS TO HUF347.8MLN.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY HYPO-BANK BOOSTS 96 PROFITS TO HUF347.8MLN.

text.p: Hypo-Bank Hungaria Rt, a unit of Germany's Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG , posted after-tax profits of 347.8 million forints in 1996, up from 304.4 million forints in 1995, Hypo-Bank said on Friday.
The figures are calculated according to the Hungarian accounting standards.
"(1996) was the year of successful expansion in every field," Hypo-Bank Managing Director Istvan Ottrubay told a news conference.

Hypo-Bank group, including the brokerage Hypo-Securities Rt and the leasing firm Hypo-Leasing Kft, both having their first full business year in 1996, posted a pre-tax profit of some 610 million forints last year, Ottrubay said.
Hypo-Bank almost doubled its balance sheet total to 40.2 billion forints in 1996 from 22.4 billion forints in 1995.
The bank's deposits soared by 56 percent to 21.06 billion forints last year, while loans surged by 147 percent to 20.65 billion forints, Ottrubay added.

Hypo-Bank will continue expansion, adding at least three branches to the current seven in 1997, and completing the enlargement of its network in 1998, when it plans to have 20 branches, the bank said in a statement.
Hypo-Bank is likely to pay a dividend of one percent for 1996, a bank official said.
